note: Every card and Crown Project. "svg" entries show the original scene from src/games/clockwork/ui/art.ts; none are generated paintings. "asset" is set when a finished image replaces one. Workflow in docs/CLOCKWORK.md.
style: Minimalist medieval editorial illustration: soft flat shapes, burgundy, antique gold, warm ivory and charcoal with muted natural colours. People without detailed faces, inhabited places, no text, no machinery, 16:9, readable when small.
